// PowerData: CAN ID 0x500 (standard), 8 bytes, sender ECM
//
// Decode pseudo-code generated by CanViewer from demo.dbc.
// data[0] .. data[7] are the payload bytes; bit 0 is the least significant bit of a byte.
// Shifts and masks work on unsigned integers wide enough for the signal.
// float32(x) and float64(x) read the bits of x as an IEEE 754 single or double.

// BatteryVoltage: start bit 0, 32 bits, Intel, float32 (IEEE 754), factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 100 V
BatteryVoltage_raw = data[0] | (data[1] << 8) | (data[2] << 16) | (data[3] << 24)
BatteryVoltage = float32(BatteryVoltage_raw)

// Consumption: start bit 32, 16 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 0.1, offset 0, range 0 .. 6553.5 l/h
Consumption_raw = data[4] | (data[5] << 8)
Consumption = Consumption_raw * 0.1
